bagPolicy.summary: Small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6”x 9” and clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6” are allowed. All bags are subject to search upon entry.
allowed: Clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at lots surrounding the waterfront with varying prices. For easier entry and exit, consider Premier Parking or VIP Parking. Accessible parking is available, with Lot 1 being the closest to the venue.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Freedom Mortgage Pavilion's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Freedom Mortgage Pavilion offers a variety of food and drink options including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Koko's Bavarian provides German-inspired sausages and pretzels, while CVT offers premium soft serve ice cream. General concessions include popcorn, nachos, and a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Freedom Mortgage Pavilion's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Freedom Mortgage Pavilion. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Freedom Mortgage Pavilion. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
